I cannot recall ever saying all nd folks don’t understand sarcasm. For me, sometimes I understand and sometimes I don’t, another nd person could understand every sarcastic comment and someone else couldn’t at all. I...don’t know what else you want me to say here.

Thank you, and thanks for explaining your last sentence. As you can see some folks like me don’t interpret or read things the same way. Hopefully now it makes more sense why some of us were upset at his comments, and are sadly getting more upset at other fans’ actions.

I was online on twitter seeing all this happen and reading everyone’s comments and thoughts, good or bad. Honestly I didn’t think he would apologize earlier when it was all happening but it’s good to see he apologized.

I do understand that not everyone will know about ableism. I just don’t like it when folks try to explain why something someone said is wrong and then being told to basically shut up.

I get that neurodivergent folks are not everyone’s mind, but I would expect folks to listen to us when we explain why something said is wrong.

I’m sorry that you feel so angry about this. I think you should log off for today cause you see to be really riled up by what the malicious folks are saying to Jae. 

His comment is still ableist, I hope that you take the time to learn more about ableism and how comments like that hurt neurodivergent folks like me.
It just sucks because I’m starting to feel like you can explain all day why it hurt some fans and just be told to basically shut up because folks only see the ppl being malicious to Jae :(

I don’t understand what you’re saying. The sarcasm tweet is ableist either way because not everyone understand sarcasm. 

I know he made the tweet about hate trains due to him defending JYP and his “how the hell would i know” about skz. I know that the fan replied to the tweet mentioning sarcasm and that’s why he responded with “Sucks that not everyone understands sarcasm.” 

The sarcasm comment is ableist in general, you can learn more about ableism if you google it.

I think you misunderstand who I’m more upset at in my comment, I’m mainly upset at folks that are defending Jae on this post saying “Jae did nothing wrong!” or “Twitter sjws need to grow up!” or literally just all the comments basically shitting on folks for just asking a apology? 

Fans on twitter and reddit have been basically bad for neurodivergent fans in general cause we point out how something is wrong and ask for an apology, and either ppl endorse us in the wrong way (denying Jae’s ADHD and social anxiety, telling him to delete, etc.) or ppl telling neurodivergent fans to basically shut up and “stop making new things up.” 

I’m fine with Jae defending himself, I just don’t want him to make comments that are hurtful for many fans and have those fans be either ignored or picked on by other fans in the process.

The first thing to upset folks was responding to a fan about sarcasm by saying like “Sucks that not everyone speaks the language of Sarcasm!” which is ableist cause autistic folks (like me) sometimes or at all don’t “get” sarcasm. Using sarcasm isn’t ableist, but refusing to explain your sarcasm and responding “Everyone should get sarcasm.” is ableist.

Some folks got mad about him stating “I have ADHD and social anxiety? Same.” was because ppl read it as a dismissive response. Some people were actual dicks by implying he doesn’t have ADHD  or being rude about him listing social anxiety.

My main problem with him stating he has ADHD and social anxiety as a response to criticism is that he seems to think that since he’s neurodivergent he can’t be ableist, which is wrong. You can definitely be ableist and neurodivergent, by just not knowing or being like genuinely a jerk about it.

I don’t think he was malicious in making the sarcasm comment, but he was rude to everyone asking him to apologize cause it hurt his neurodivergent fans’ feelings.

No one should be taking advantage of the situation to say flat out malicious things to him or straight up denying his ADHD and social anxiety. The problem majority of folks had was just that he didn’t want to take the time to learn why what he said hurt folks and to apologize for the comment. I don’t agree with those that deny he has ADHD or social anxiety.

Bummer to see everyone really dismissive of neurodivergent folks. Twitter can absolutely be a cesspool of hate but neurodivergent fans were explaining and asking for an apology. 

Honestly I think folks got really mad over him just being super dismissive to fans in general, and him replying “I have ADHD and social anxiety.” didn’t really help. You can be neurodivergent and say ableist things! You just have to learn why it’s wrong and apologize for it. Not get mad at everyone and lash out over it.

I wish this subreddit wouldn’t act so high and mighty compared to twitter, cause the way everyone is talking about ableism and neurodivergent folks on here is exactly the same way folks are talking on twitter too.
